title: Cleaning dimension identity for isotropic subspaces
statement:
Let $p$ be prime and let $S \le V = \bbf_p^n \times \bbf_p^n$ be a subspace that is isotropic for the symplectic form $\omega$, meaning $\omega(u,v)=0$ for all $u,v \in S$. Then for every subset $M \subseteq \{0,\dots,n-1\}$, with complement $M^c$,
\[
g(S,M) + g(S,M^c) = 2n - 2\dim_{\bbf_p} S,
\]
where $g(S,M) = \dim_{\bbf_p}\!\big(S^{\perp}_M\big) - \dim_{\bbf_p}\!\big(S_M\big)$.
hypotheses_covered: p is prime (F_p is a field)
S is a subspace of V = F_p^n × F_p^n
S is isotropic for the symplectic form ω
